def outer():
 x=7
 def f():
  nonlocal x
  x+=1
 return f
f=outer()
print(exec(f.__code__,closure=f.__closure__),f.__closure__[0].cell_contents)

def outer():
 a=7
 b=9
 def f():
  nonlocal a,b
  a,b=b,a
 return f
f=outer()
exec(f.__code__,{},closure=f.__closure__)
print(f.__closure__[0].cell_contents,f.__closure__[1].cell_contents)

def outer():
 x=7
 def f():
  nonlocal x
  x+=1
 return f
f=outer()
g=outer()
g.__closure__[0].cell_contents=13
exec(f.__code__,closure=g.__closure__)
print(f.__closure__[0].cell_contents,g.__closure__[0].cell_contents)

def f():
 print("called")
 return 7
print(exec(f.__code__))

def f():
 print("body")
 yield 7
print(exec(f.__code__))
